item.title: Everett-born Seahawks player to speak at State of the City
item.description: Abe Lucas, an offensive tackle who won a Super Bowl ring just a few weeks ago, will open the event, the Greater Everett Chamber of Commerce announced.

item.title: Comment: How is Putin’s war in Ukraine playing in Russia?
item.description: Russians’ support may be more fragile than many assume.

item.title: Letter: Lakewood district failed to protect students who walked out for protest
item.description: I recently read an article posted on HeraldNet referencing a walkout by students attending Lakewood High School and Maddle School (“Lakewood student walkout ends after man makes alleged threats,” The Herald, Feb. 6). I am very concerned that the schools allow students to participate in such events where they are led to believe it’s OK. item.title: Letter: Don’t tax nicotine pouches like cigarettes
item.description: The Washington State Legislature should repeal its 95 percent tax on nicotine pouches.

item.title: Letter: Thanks for focus on tire chemical’s threat to coho salmon
item.description: I read your editorial regarding 6PPD and House Bill 2410, and want to thank you sincerely for the coverage (“Set deadline for chemical in tires that’s killing coho,” The Herald, Feb. 17). It was a well-written article with good corollary material and quotes.
